pro-life.evidence: Voted Yea on CS/HB 289 (2026, House 76-34 on 01/15/2026). The bill lets parents sue for the wrongful death of an unborn child and bars suits against the mother or against providers of lawful medical care, so it does not itself restrict abortion; abortion-rights groups opposed it.

slow-growth-protect-land.evidence: Prime sponsor of HB 1317 (2026), which bars new oil and gas facilities and state permits or leases for them in specified Gulf waters and submerged lands near the Eastern Gulf Test and Training Range; it died in committee.
